definitions.explanation: An examination held at fixed intervals, especially the midterm and final exams in Japanese schools. Also used for regularly scheduled professional or medical examinations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定期試験|ていきしけん}だ。
examples.english: We have regular exams next week.

examples.japanese: {定期試験|ていきしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The scope of the periodic exam hasn't been announced yet.

examples.japanese: {定期試験|ていきしけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I've promised to go out with friends after the regular exams are over.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧ (regular, periodic) and ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (examination, test). In Japanese schools, {定期試験|ていきしけん} typically refers to the midterm (⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧) and final (⟦{期末|きまつ}→期末：22375_kimatsu⟧) exams held each term. Most Japanese middle and high schools hold these exams two to three times per year.

During {定期試験|ていきしけん} periods, club activities are usually suspended so students can focus on studying. Results significantly influence report card grades.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定期試験|ていきしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧: studying for regular exams
- {定期試験|ていきしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧: exam scope
- {定期試験|ていきしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: exam results
- {定期試験|ていきしけん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: exam period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}→中間試験：06691_chuukanshiken⟧: midterm exam — a specific type of {定期試験|ていきしけん}
- ⟦{期末試験|きまつしけん}→期末試験：06690_kimatsushiken⟧: final exam — another specific type
- ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: achievement test — tests overall ability, not tied to a specific unit of study
- ⟦{小|しょう}テスト→小テスト：27557_shoutesuto⟧: quiz — shorter, less formal test covering recent material
